summary.name: Podman Desktop
summary.one_liner: Podman Desktop is a free, open source graphical tool for developing and managing containers and Kubernetes locally on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
use_cases: developing and testing Kubernetes workloads locally
running local AI models in containers with GPU acceleration
summary.what_it_does: Podman Desktop provides a graphical interface to create, manage, and delete containers on Linux, macOS, and Windows. It integrates with popular container runtimes, registries, and developer tools, and supports OCI and Compose. For Kubernetes, it works with Podman's native Kubernetes support or local Kind or Minikube clusters, and lets users inspect and manage pods, services, and deployments. It also offers access to logs, metrics, and debug tools, plus an extension system. The page states it supports GPU acceleration for local AI workloads, multi-arch builds, and VPN/proxy and air-gapped installs.
notable: Open source and vendor-neutral, part of the CNCF
Daemonless, rootless containers with SELinux support via the Podman runtime
Native Kubernetes support plus Kind and Minikube cluster management
Extensions system and multi-arch build support
caveats: Red Hat Build of Podman Desktop with enterprise support and long-term maintenance is a separate commercial offering
Enterprise support and production-ready builds are sold separately, not part of the free tool
